def matrix_free_spectral_embedding(
    counts: np.ndarray,
    n_components: int,
    random_state: int = 0,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return leading spectral coordinates for a cell-by-feature count matrix."""

    # Validate inputs
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all():
        raise ValueError("Input contains non-finite values.")
    if (counts < 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Input contains negative values.")
    if (counts.sum(axis=1) == 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Input contains all-zero cell rows.")
    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be in range [1, n_cells).")

    # Define matrix-free linear operator for the Gram matrix counts @ counts.T
    def matvec(v):
        return counts @ (counts.T @ v)

    from scipy.sparse.linalg import LinearOperator, eigsh

    op = LinearOperator((n_cells, n_cells), matvec=matvec, dtype=counts.dtype)

    # Set initial vector for reproducibility
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
    v0 = rng.rand(n_cells)

    # Compute leading eigenvalues and eigenvectors
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(op, k=n_components, which='LA', v0=v0)

    # Sort descending by eigenvalue
    idx = np.argsort(eigenvalues)[::-1]
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[idx]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, idx]

    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors
